text:
maya: Heads up — vendor just confirmed a partial allocation for our APAC demo pool. 8x A100 + 4x L40s arriving Thu. Need to confirm rotation operator behavior for mixed-SKU pools. Anyone oncall for infra to check allocator rules?

alex: Oof mixed SKUs. Which pool id / quota? can you paste the vendor email?

maya: pasted snippet:
```
PoolID: red-demo-apac-02
SKUs: A100(8), L40(4)
ETA: 2025-06-12 18:00 UTC
Note: allocation-token required for ingress
```

maya: Also vendor asked we pass `allocation_token` at attach time.

sam: I can take this. Does our rotation-operator currently respect per-SKU affinity? Last time it pushed smaller jobs onto incompatible nodes and failed.

jin: It defaults to bin-packing across capacity classes. We do have a feature flag `prefer_homogeneous_scheduling`. For mixed pools, set that + per-tenant sku constraints or it will try to maximize utilization.

sam: Where is the flag in repo? I'll add a terraform var if needed.

jin: It's in infra/allocator config: `rotation_operator.mode = "affinity" | "binpack"` default = "binpack". For this pool use `affinity` + `pool.tags = ["homogeneous-preferred"]`.

alex: @nora do we have budget for reserving the whole pool for demos? Vendor prefers a short monthly commit to guarantee ETA.

nora: Budget note: if demo window <72h we can cover with demo credits (one-off). If they force monthly commit we'll need procurement signoff. How long is the window?

maya: 48h next Wed-Thu (two full days). One-off reservation makes sense.

sam: I'll open a PR to set the pool tags, flip the operator mode for just that pool, and add a canary job. Ping me for review.

maya: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/+/5624 — canary job `smoke/demo-smoke-apac` scheduled 2025-06-12T20:00Z. Canary will run a short infer + KV-cache warm up.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: partial provisioning scheduled. Allocation link: https://vendor.example/alloc/RED-APAC-02 (status: pending attach)

alex: Also note: cloud provider needs a quota bump for L40s in apac-east1. @eng-cloud who owns the quota request?

jin: I got it — filing quota case now, will paste case id once created.

nora: :thumbsup:

sam: For safety I'll add a fallback policy on the pool: `"fallback": ["h100-ephemeral", "a100-spot"]` so demos survive partial attach failures.

maya: Great — thanks. Plan: wait for sam's PR, jin's quota case id, then confirm vendor attach. tagging @oncall in case attach spikes errors.

alex: One more ask — can we add a short heatmap on the console to show per-sku slot availability for red-demo-apac-02 during attach window? would help SRE watch it.

jin: Good call. I'll spin up a short dashboard and link it in the PR.

sam: Will include dashboard link in PR description.

maya: Awesome. I'll update vendor that we're prepping an affinity canary + fallback and will confirm attach once PR + quota are green. :eyes:
